text:
Matt B: CI red on master — flaky unit failing in runtime/serving: `kv_cache_eviction_test` (build 4821). Failing ~3/10 runs. @Ashley K @Lee H can you take a quick look? <https://ci.internal/builds/4821>

Ashley K: On it. Can you paste the failing log snippet?

Matt B: Log:
```
AssertionError: expected 3 entries after eviction, got 2
  at kv_cache::evict_if_needed (runtime/cache.cc:142)
  at tests::kv_cache_eviction_test (tests/kv_cache_test.cc:58)
```

Lee H: Sounds like nondeterministic timing — test uses sleeps + background eviction thread. Could be a race where eviction hasn't completed before assert. I'll try a bisect but need a reliable repro locally. @ci-bot can you re-run the job with `--debug` and `--repeat 10`?

ci-bot: Re-run requested by Lee H — queued as 4821-rerun-2 (debug + repeat).

ci-bot: Rerun complete: 4821-rerun-2 -> PASS (original still failed).

Sara P: Passing on rerun but original failed — classic flaky. Short term: add a targeted CI retry for this test. Medium term: make the test deterministic: avoid `sleep`, use `wait_for_condition()` or fake clock, and assert with a timeout-based wait.

Ashley K: Agree. I'll replace `sleep(100)` with `wait_for_condition([](){ return cache.size()==3; }, 500ms)` and add a comment about flakiness. Also add a deterministic eviction hook in test utils.

Matt B: Also possible recent batching change touched cache timing — failing range looks like `abc123..def456`. Lee, can you run: 
```
git bisect start HEAD abc123
git bisect run ./scripts/run_kv_test.sh
```
and let it run overnight?

Lee H: Will kick off the bisect now. I'll leave it running and post results tomorrow morning. Also propose tagging the test as `@flake` so CI can auto-rerun once before marking red. Anyone object?

Sara P: :thumbsup: no objections. Also add a one-liner in the test so future devs know it's timing-sensitive.

Ashley K: Assigned to me. I'll open a small PR today with the wait-for-condition fix + test comment + short-term CI retry rule. Will paste PR link here when ready.

Matt B: Thanks. Ping me when PR is up and I'll review quickly. For the short term I've added a pipeline rule to rerun that single test once automatically (should reduce noise while we fix). :white_check_mark:

Lee H: Bisect started — leaving terminal attached to `tmux` and will update thread with commit that introduced regression.

ci-bot: Notifying owners: @Ashley K, @Lee H — build 4821 marked flaky and set to auto-rerun once.
